comment: The manual says probability "affects all logic outputs equally"; the code keeps a separate latch and makes a separate random draw for each of the six outputs (applyProbabilityLatch is called once per output with its own index), so at a partial setting the outputs are suppressed independently rather than together. The manual also says an unconnected input's switch can be used to force it high; the switch in fact forces the input high whether or not a cable is present, because the two are combined with a logical OR. Every jack is read with getVoltage(), so nothing is polyphonic.
